implementation.native_creation: Complete AttemptRef membership is inserted using the same caller SQLite connection; source folder must be ctx.scope/task. Unsupported phases are refused.
implementation.native_settlement: finish_attempt records a candidate only. Full execution transaction/effect/timeout/guard exit precedes terminal recheck and a separate member SETTLED transaction; its committed row is checked freshly too.
implementation.quiesce: Persistent control phase polled under context guard. Before GO, False means one nonblocking owned STOP, no GO. poll sends STOP once without recursive stop/wait or concurrent receive. Actual TREE_CLOSED is still required.
implementation.roles: Role INTENT is enrolled before return/prepare; INTENT ambiguity before enrollment marks context HOLD. Exact trigger settlement and lock release precede role member settlement.
implementation.process_ownership: Strong private members/handles retained on unknown preparation or changed public maps. Closure and action settlement are separate. STOP0 keeps actual worker returncode and interrupted outcome.
implementation.data: Bounded metadata only: identities, full refs, hashes/counts, READY and closure; no argv/environment/output body persistence.
implementation.resource_bounds: 4096 total members per instance, including settled history, no unknown eviction; pending intents and held owners retained. Not an unlimited-run lifecycle policy.
